# ANALYSIS: WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE OOS Re-score with 3-4 day OPRA data

**Filed:** 2026-07-23
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** analysis

## Summary

We re-score the WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE strategy using the newly backfilled 3-4-day OPRA data to compute edge_capture (OP-16 anchors), aggregate Sharpe, and walk-forward stability across 2025Q3-2026Q2 quarters. The goal is to confirm the previously observed +82% exp/tr monotone (0DTE→1DTE→2DTE) and see if it extends to 3DTE and 4DTE.

## Hypothesis

The edge captured by holding the same directional signal (ITM-2, -8%/+30%) at longer DTE continues to increase monotonically with DTE due to reduced theta decay, at least up to 4DTE.

## Mechanism (unchanged)

Buy the same directional signal (e.g., vwap_continuation) at longer DTE (1,2,3,4 day weekly) instead of 0DTE; same strike (ITM-2) + same exit (-8%/+30%); isolates the DTE variable.
